exhaustedMorning: You were too worn out to work. The whole morning went.
dinnerMissed: You did not go to the dinner at Thornwall. The next day nobody on the estate mentioned it.
millridgeShortOfTrust: You asked, at Millridge. The two of you are not on those terms yet.
insolvencyDismissed: The Baron’s man came in the morning with half a sheet of paper: payment stops today, hand over within three days.
insolvencyTenantsLeaving: Another day and not one account settled. There were fewer people in the fields than yesterday.
insolvencyRenownSpending: Another day and not one account settled. Word of a thing like that travels fast in the valley.
